steps.label: prep
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/cable/"* . && rm -rf s r && bash prep.sh

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && for i in $(seq 1 40); do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b cable.blend -P cable_render.py -- render 1 1450 100 >> rall.log 2>&1; n=$(ls r | wc -l); echo "pass $i frames $n"; [ $n -ge 1450 ] && break; sleep 5; done; ls r | wc -l

steps.label: encode
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 25 -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main/r/f%04d.jpg" -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main/cable_mix.m4a" -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -shortest -movflags +faststart "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main/cable_1080.mp4" && ls -l "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main/cable_1080.mp4"
